d: Manage governance, risk management, and compliance activities across construction programs and projects to ensure adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and industry best practices.

Support the establishment and maintenance of effective governance frameworks, risk controls, compliance monitoring processes, and assurance activities that promote project integrity, transparency, and operational excellence.
Drive proactive risk identification, compliance oversight, and governance reporting to support successful project delivery and organizational objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Risk Management, Law, Finance, or a related field.
PMP, PMI-RMP, CRMP, CIA, CISA, ISO 31000, or equivalent professional certification preferred.
6–10 years of progressive experience in governance, risk management, compliance, construction controls, audit, project management, or related disciplines.
Supporting governance and compliance activities within large-scale construction, infrastructure, real estate, or capital project environments.
Conducting risk assessments, compliance reviews, and assurance activities.
Developing governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and control mechanisms.
Working with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, consultants, and regulatory stakeholders.
Preparing governance reporting, risk analysis, and executive-level presentations.
r: Implement and maintain construction governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks across assigned projects and programs.
Monitor compliance with organizational policies, governance requirements, regulatory obligations, and project controls standards.
Facilitate risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and risk monitoring activities across construction portfolios.
Conduct governance reviews, compliance assessments, audits, and assurance activities to evaluate adherence to established requirements.
Track and report governance, compliance, and risk management performance indicators and key metrics.
Support the development and implementation of risk registers, control frameworks, compliance plans, and governance procedures.
Coordinate corrective actions, mitigation plans, and continuous improvement initiatives arising from audit findings or compliance reviews.
Collaborate with Project Delivery, Commercial, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Internal Audit, and Risk functions to address governance and compliance matters.
Review project governance documentation, approvals, delegations, and decision-making processes to ensure compliance with established requirements.
Support regulatory engagement activities and facilitate responses to governance, compliance, and risk-related inquiries.
Prepare governance reports, executive dashboards, risk summaries, and committee presentations.
Promote risk awareness, compliance culture, and governance best practices across project teams and stakeholders.

d: The Operations Lead is the in-country person accountable for the safe, reliable and compliant operation and maintenance of the Muscat hydrogen refuelling station. The role is the primary client contact, leads site technicians, manages maintenance and fault response, and ensures contractual performance and reporting.

The station produces hydrogen on site and is operated and maintained by Hydrogen Systems for the owner. Key assets include the electrolyser, hydrogen compressors, storage vessels and pressure relief valves, chiller/coolant system, dispenser, hoses/nozzles, and safety systems (hydrogen/flame detection, emergency shutdown, alarms and sprinklers). Sensors provide real-time monitoring, supported by a 24/7 remote operations service. The owner retains control of the asset; all changes, including software updates, require approval through its Management of Change (MoC) process.
Client operations/facilities team: daily focal point; obtains work approvals and attends performance reviews.
Site and duty technicians: assigns and supervises work, checks quality and develops competence.
Remote operations support: manages alarm escalations, coordinates call-outs and closes incidents.
Hydrogen Systems teams in Riyadh: obtains engineering, procurement, quality, safety and specialist support.
Manufacturers/subcontractors: arranges and supervises specialist visits.
Station users/fleet operators: communicates planned downtime and minimizes disruption.
q: Degree in mechanical, electrical, instrumentation or chemical engineering, or a technical diploma with substantial operations experience.
At least 8 years' operations and maintenance experience in gas, process or energy facilities, including 3 years leading a site or technician team.
Hands-on experience with high-pressure gas equipment, including compressors, storage, chillers and dispensing systems.
Working knowledge of permit-to-work, safe isolation and risk assessment for pressurized/flammable gas equipment.
Preventive maintenance planning and CMMS experience; ability to read P&IDs, electrical drawings and manufacturer manuals.
Experience as the main client contact under a service contract with response-time obligations.
Clear spoken and written English; right to work in Oman or ability to obtain it; valid Oman driving licence. Omani nationals are encouraged.
Hydrogen experience, including electrolysers, diaphragm/piston compressors or hydrogen refuelling stations.
Experience at public-facing fuel sites or with international energy-company clients.
Manufacturer training, root-cause/reliability, commissioning/start-up or recognized site-safety qualification.
Operational technology/industrial control cybersecurity experience, including IEC 62443, ISA or NIST Cybersecurity Framework awareness and vendor remote-access management.

Ownership and follow-through; clear and timely client communication; disciplined maintenance planning and record keeping; sound cross-disciplinary technical judgement; strong safety leadership; cybersecurity awareness; technician development and team leadership; and commercial understanding of contract scope, obligations and variations.

Based in Muscat with regular station attendance; not a remote or rotational role. On call outside working hours and able to reach site quickly during emergencies. Requires outdoor work in high temperatures and around high-pressure hydrogen equipment, with occasional travel to Riyadh and manufacturer facilities for training and reviews.
r: Manage daily station operations and maintain customer availability.
Complete and record daily, weekly and monthly inspections of compressors, chiller, dispenser and storage systems.
Lead alarm and fault response, assess severity, troubleshoot remotely/on site and restore service within contractual response and resolution times.
Investigate recurring faults, document root causes and implement lasting corrective actions.
Maintain a clean, secure and safely accessible site.
Agree the annual maintenance calendar with the client by November of the preceding year and deliver scheduled work.
Coordinate preventive and corrective tasks to reduce downtime and cost.
Prepare work instructions, method statements, risk assessments, downtime estimates and spare-parts requirements.
Schedule statutory and third-party inspections and maintain accurate CMMS records.
Issue a maintenance report within one week after each completed task.
Obtain client approval before maintenance/service work and provide effort estimates before corrective work.
Track corrective maintenance hours against the contract allowance.
Process equipment, software, cybersecurity and remote-access changes through the owner's MoC process; complete cybersecurity reviews and task risk assessments before remote upgrades.
Consult the client before scrapping replaced parts, provide performance/data visibility, and manage approved improvement proposals.
Manage spare parts, wear parts, consumables and nitrogen in accordance with manufacturer and quality requirements.
Raise timely purchase requests for critical items and update the client on delivery dates and repair dependencies.
Report agreed KPIs accurately and on time, lead client performance reviews and maintain current operating procedures.
Ensure technicians and critical spares are available to avoid liquidated damages.
Support quarterly in-country value reporting and Omani recruitment and training plans.
Direct technicians' daily activities, prioritize and allocate work according to competence, and review completed tasks.
Maintain valid training, certifications and site-access credentials.
Provide hydrogen safety training to client personnel and third parties; develop team capability so critical tasks are not dependent on one individual.
Protect operational technology and industrial control systems, including SCADA and PLCs, in line with the owner's cybersecurity requirements.
Approve, time-limit and log remote access by company staff and vendors; remove access when no longer required.
Keep software, firmware and security patches current through the MoC process.
Maintain an inventory of controllers, network devices, software/firmware versions, user accounts and backups.
Promptly report suspected incidents or breaches, support investigations and cybersecurity audits, and close resulting actions.
Lead site safety, pursue zero harm and stop unsafe work. Comply with client standards and IOGP Life-Saving Rules.
Enforce permit-to-work, safe isolation, depressurization and purging requirements for hydrogen equipment.
Ensure suitable risk assessments, job hazard analyses and isolation plans are in place for each task.
Maintain required safety passports and permit/safe-isolation qualifications for self and technicians.
Lead emergency response, reaching the site/affected person in under 15 minutes when at risk.
Test hydrogen/flame detectors, emergency shutdowns, alarms and sprinklers; conduct routine leak checks.
Report and investigate incidents and near misses, share lessons learned and protect worker welfare.
Safety: zero harm and no permit-to-work or Life-Saving Rules breaches.
Emergency involving a site/person at risk: response within 15 minutes.
Loss of primary function (no refuelling): respond and resolve within 2 hours in 90% of cases.
Reduced performance: respond within 72 hours and resolve within 2 days in 90% of cases.
Loss of secondary function: respond within 72 hours.
Preventive maintenance: annual calendar agreed by November; all tasks completed as scheduled.
Maintenance reports: issued within one week of task completion.
Corrective hours: tracked against the annual contractual allowance.
Liquidated damages: none due to late response or unavailable technicians/spares.
Availability/KPIs: targets agreed with the client and reviewed through performance meetings.
Where maintenance is required to resolve a fault, the resolution schedule must be agreed with the client.

d: The Lean Store team owns some of Lean's most revenue-critical and compliance-sensitive infrastructure — from payouts and billing to the regulatory ledger underpinning ADGM and SwiftX growth. As a Senior Software Engineer on this squad, you'll take full ownership of core systems, drive delivery on committed integrations, and ensure the reliability of infrastructure that processes millions in transactions. This is a hands-on execution role for an engineer who thrives on owning domains end-to-end.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 350+ clients — from Binance and Careem to Etisalat — and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: Strong backend engineering in Java, Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, microservices, and REST APIs
Production experience with Kafka for event-driven systems
Data layer proficiency: PostgreSQL and Redis
Familiarity with build and delivery tooling: Maven, Docker, Jenkins
Observability mindset: Prometheus and Grafana in production environments
Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling (e.g. Claude) in day-to-day work
Ability to own a domain independently — handle most backlog items without direction, drive design decisions, and contribute to tech specs
Writes high-quality, secure, fully tested code with solid monitoring and alerting
Clear communicator — able to explain technical risk to both engineers and leadership
Reliable on commitments; unblocks the squad and escalates early when needed
Experience working within regulated financial environments

NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!
r: Build and maintain core ledger functionality that underpins Lean's SwiftX compliance use case and regulatory requirements for ADGM scaling
Own the billing system end-to-end — its reliability, maintenance, and ongoing evolution
Deliver on the Mal integration, a strategically committed new integration with direct revenue implications
Cover ongoing payouts infrastructure — incident response, client features, and DC-related work — ensuring SLA adherence on a live revenue stream
Drive stability, performance, and scalability improvements proactively across the squad's domain
Give design-level code reviews, contribute to refinement, and write clear technical specifications

Since 2019, we’ve become the first regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We’ve processed billions of dollars. We connect millions of accounts.
